verdict.rationale: The evidence documents session-level observability: rich logs, live view of a browser session, and session replay. It also shows a dashboard used for creating agents and optimizing runs. Nothing documents a real-time dashboard of system metrics or browser/worker pool status, such as concurrency usage, pool health, or capacity. Per-session live view is an adjacent feature, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can monitor live system metrics and worker/browser pool status through a real-time dashboard
